feeds.title: The Peaceful Haven
feeds.description: The Peaceful Haven is an engaging lifestyle blog. Janelle blogs about life including homemaking, parenting, autism, gluten-free living, health, finances, simple living all from a Christian perspective.

feeds.title: Heavenly Homemakers
feeds.description: We offer daily encouragement for women in the areas of faith, healthy eating, family friendly recipes, menu planning, gardening, parenting, and fun.

feeds.title: Proverbial Homemaker Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Tauna wife to a wonderful man and a homeschool mom to six. My goal is to encourage you and connect you with tools and resources to help you in your daily life. Here's what you'll find at Proverbial Homemaker: Homeschooling and family discipleship, Keeping the home, and Encouragement for your walk with Christ

feeds.title: Healthy Christian Home
feeds.description: Healthy Christian Home explores how to nourish families physically and spiritually through healthy recipes and God's Word. Christ-follower, Wife, Mama, Health Enthusiast, & Real Food Lover. Let's learn how to take care of our body & spirit!

feeds.title: Homemaking Organized
feeds.description: On Homemaking Organized blog, you'll find a little bit of homemaking advice a few deals and sales, and all the mish-mash in between. It provides resources for keeping your home organized.

feeds.title: Thankful Homemaker Blog
feeds.description: Marci Ferrell is a Christian wife, mother & grandmother who loves to share about her walk with the Lord, her passion for biblical womanhood and living all of life for the glory of God. She has been celebrating the joy, freedom and beauty of being a wife, mother and homemaker on her blog.

feeds.title: Titus 2 Homemaker
feeds.description: The Titus 2 Homemaker blog deals with the nitty-gritty of life in the trenches as a Christian homeschooling mama attempting to live a healthful lifestyle. The blog offers commiseration, encouragement, and practical ideas rooted in what she is learning on her own journey.

feeds.title: Homemaking 911
feeds.description: Homemaking 911 is a place where Christian women come together to discuss homemaking, home education, and being a godly wife and mother.

feeds.title: Imperfect Homemaker
feeds.description: Imperfect Homemaker is all about christian homemaking, homeschooling, and natural living. Follow for inspiration and encouragement!

feeds.title: News Anchor to Homemaker Blog
feeds.description: News Anchor to Homemaker is a Down syndrome blog that focuses on real-life inspiring special needs stories and parenting articles from a Christian faith perspective, written by Jillian Benfield.

feeds.title: The Remedial Homemaker Blog
feeds.description: The Remedial Homemaker is all about a christian Women Learning to Love God's Design. Mindy's hope is that she can offer women encouragement and a dose of inspiration as she, along with the readers, learns to love this whole homemaker thing

feeds.title: The Latina Homemaker
feeds.description: On The Latina Homemaker blog, Jesenia Montanez has been sharing homemaking tips, frugal living advice, recipes and more.

feeds.title: The Humbled Homemaker Blog
feeds.description: The Humbled Homemaker is a Christian homemaking blog that encourages women to pursue grace-filled, natural living in mothering, cooking, alternative health, and living on a low income.
